Set catalog categories/topics; footer library count 227

- Initial release of the "reverse-information-paradox" skill, based on Satya Nadella’s July 2026 strategic thesis.
- Diagnoses risks of revealing proprietary knowledge (“intelligence exhaust”) when using external AI systems, and prescribes trust boundary and orchestration decoupling strategies.
- Activates for enterprise/SMB users assessing data, evals, or learning loops flowing to AI vendors, especially regarding data ownership and competitive leakage.
- Includes step-by-step guidance for both experienced users (“Engine mode”) and novices (“Coach mode”) on mapping exhaust and making trust-boundary decisions.
- Clearly states when *not* to use: e.g., with fully local/self-hosted models, non-proprietary tasks, or if acting as the AI provider.
